findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "crypto-tax" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto-tax_tax-loss-harvest · Private data: crypto-tax_germany-holding-period · Public sink: crypto-tax_cost-basis-lots, crypto-tax_specific-id-select, crypto-tax_us-form-8949-rows, crypto-tax_uk-share-pooling, crypto-tax_canada-acb, crypto-tax_australia-cgt-discount, crypto-tax_germany-holding-period, crypto-tax_income-events-value, crypto-tax_transfer-match, crypto-tax_network-fee-allocate, crypto-tax_tax-loss-harvest, crypto-tax_derivatives-pnl, crypto-tax_unrealized-snapshot, crypto-tax_exchange-csv-normalize, crypto-tax_missing-basis-detect · Destructive: crypto-tax_cost-basis-lots, crypto-tax_specific-id-select, crypto-tax_us-form-8949-rows, crypto-tax_uk-share-pooling, crypto-tax_canada-acb, crypto-tax_australia-cgt-discount, crypto-tax_germany-holding-period, crypto-tax_income-events-value, crypto-tax_transfer-match, crypto-tax_network-fee-allocate, crypto-tax_tax-loss-harvest, crypto-tax_derivatives-pnl, crypto-tax_unrealized-snapshot, crypto-tax_exchange-csv-normalize, crypto-tax_missing-basis-detect.
